body: Accepted. Updated focused evidence is 16/16 on JVM, JS, and Native; repository-wide testJVM was also green before these nonsemantic follow-ups. V1 evidence containment and V3 deterministic receipted lanes move into the next CodexCompiler/CodexSpec bead, with StoryRef.Situation as the normal narrative annotation target. V4 is settled: modelReceiptChecksum remains explicit and optional until canonical model serialization supplies a true content checksum. The Intaglio report now uses the final view and Address/ViewRef terminology. I will close the foundation bead and create the compiler bead. I will not commit or push the shared working tree without explicit user authorization.
